Lincoln Square Flats
1 bed 1 bath apartment, 505 S Neil St, Champaign IL 61820
$1.950 per month  (Dep $1,350)
Washer/dryer in unit, dishwasher, central air, built 2019.
Covered parking $60/mo. Pets by approval only, 25 lb limit, $300 deposit.
Utilities: tenant pays water, sewer and trash through RUBS (avg $55/mo for water and sewer). Electric billed by Ameren.
Typical total bills $140 per month.
